```yaml
name: Bump personal server after release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump:
    if: github.event.release.prerelease == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout hushline repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set version
        id: vars
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          VERSION=${TAG#v}
          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout personal server repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          ref: main
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: personal-server

      - name: Update files
        run: |
          cd personal-server
          sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}/" hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control
          sed -i "s#hushline/hushline:[^ ]*#hushline/hushline:${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}#" hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          cd personal-server
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git commit -m "Bump personal server to ${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/bump-version-${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}

      - name: Create pull request
        id: create-pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: personal-server
          branch: bump-version-${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}
          title: "Bump personal server to ${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}"
          body: |
            Automated bump of personal server to match Hush Line release ${{ steps.vars.outputs.VERSION }}.
          base: main
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Merge pull request
        uses: peter-evans/merge-pull-request@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ steps.create-pr.outputs.pull-request-number }}
          merge-method: squash
          delete-branch: true
```
